title: AIR CONDITIONING-HEATER HOSES
summary: Air conditioning (C60) cars with the 454 engine: heater and coolant hose routing in the engine compartment between the radiator supply tank (surge tank), water pump, intake manifold, water valve and heater core pipe. A nipple screws into the water pump; the hoses are held with hose clamps, and a clip on the radiator support (View A) carries a hose using the production screw, clamp and nut. A production hose-clip mounting hole in the fender skirt is plugged with adhesive.
